set.body: Follow-up of bd-01M35BHNDCHM6YXCKYX0544TP3. FrameBridge admits only exact affines; TemplateFlow ships 6Asym<->2009c as an ANTs composite .h5 (0-byte in the local cache). An exact fsLR route for 2009c group results needs either this capability (separately qualified against an independent implementation, with warp provenance and direction checks) or fsLR anatomy registered to 2009c / results in 6Asym. Do not approximate with an affine or a generic MNI alias. See docs/audits/group-volume-fslr-mapping.md on branch surface/group-fslr-qualification-20260923.
set.title: Nonlinear inter-template bridge (e.g. MNI152NLin6Asym<->MNI152NLin2009cAsym warp) for volume-to-surface routes
